games.description: A completed solo walk home along hostile roads. Sark dodges traffic, answers the phone’s automobile surveys, follows the map, survives the supernatural pursuit, and reaches his destination.
games.title: Ends

games.description: A long solo journey through Nerea’s nightmare. Sark searches the city and sewers, survives the haunted houses and forest maze, reaches the party, and battles the timed driving finale across repeated attempts. The successful run was recorded during a Discord stream and later replayed on this Twitch stream, with the ending and his reactions preserved.
games.title: FOBIA ...worse than fear.

games.description: Sark buys food and a ticket, rides a passenger train and explores the destination town. Unclear objectives and dialogue lead to a final search before he tries the sequel.
games.title: Russian Train Trip

games.description: Immediately after the first game, Sark tries the sequel’s long-distance train ride and investigates its time-acceleration and cosmetic DLC. The session is a short test of the initial carriage rather than the full trip.
games.title: Russian Train Trip 2
